en.text.001: Better Workflows Evidence Cinema | A film about provable completion
en.text.011: it decides how the story ends.
en.text.012: Turn Goal, Source Binding, Finder, Verifier, Ledger, Review, Action and Reconciliation into a cartoon film you can pause, rewind and give an alternative ending.
en.text.013: This is not an agent saying it is done: it shows how completion is proved.
en.text.017: Each character represents a governance responsibility that another character cannot replace.
en.text.019: Eight scenes: from intent to provable completion
en.text.020: Press play to advance automatically, or inspect each scene on the timeline. The cards on the right connect the images to records, bindings and derived state. The final scene offers two endings: complete evidence or provider outcome unknown.
en.text.022: An interactive short film about evidence, state and reconciliation
en.text.023: SANITIZED TEACHING REPLAY · NOT A LIVE RUN
en.text.026: First, put the intended outcome on film
en.text.027: Without a frozen goal, scope and acceptance criteria, there is no ending that can be replayed.
en.text.031: Choose the provider state in the final scene
en.text.032: Revalidatable inputs determine the ending; narrators do not vote on it.
en.text.038: These are sanitized teaching records. The cards cover evidence, ledger entries, findings and action state; they do not pretend that every record is the same kind of evidence.
en.text.043: Select a frame to jump to a scene
en.text.046: Derive state again from the contract, events, evidence and receipts.
en.text.049: Provider reconciliation checks what already happened; it does not send the request again.
en.text.051: Stop when the outcome is unknown
en.text.052: A missing receipt, binding drift or unresolved P0/P1 cannot be edited into a completed ending.
en.text.054: Six cartoon characters, six distinct responsibilities
en.text.055: Select a character to visit its representative scene. A Finder cannot verify its own finding; Ledger derives state only from events; Sentinel does not grant passage because the picture looks good; Echo investigates unknown outcomes without blindly resending.
en.text.057: Protect the Goal, scope and sole mutation authority.
en.text.060: Gather evidence from the exact source, retaining provenance and freshness information.
en.text.063: Preserve append-only events, then replay them deterministically.
en.text.066: Seek counter-evidence; a conflict means INCONCLUSIVE, not a vote.
en.text.069: Revalidate authority, source, review and the short-lived action token.
en.text.072: Match the provider receipt to the attempt; do not resend an unknown outcome.
en.text.075: The film is presentation; code and contracts are authoritative
en.text.076: Every scene points back to existing contracts and implementation in the repository. This page does not create runs, issue action tokens or treat generated illustrations as policy inputs.
en.text.078: Required evidence fields, typed catalog, ledger authority, terminal states, resume and completion conditions.
en.text.080: Valid events, static DAG, attempt budgets, expectedLedgerDigest and the derived ready set.
en.text.082: Revalidate the kind contract, producer, payload semantics, digest and freshness.
en.text.084: Immutable package, stable finding ID, bounded repair and final broad review.
en.text.086: Authority, sentinel, evidence, provider binding, reconciliation and the terminal completion decision.
en.text.088: Inputs, outputs and failure policies for ledger replay, evaluator replay and provider reconciliation.
en.text.090: This page is a sanitized, deterministic teaching replay. Its images and demo JSON cannot authorize push, merge, deploy or any external side effect. Graphs, animation and narration cannot replace typed evidence and provider receipts for the current revision.
en.text.091: Better Workflows Evidence Replay Cinema · Original illustrated edition
en.text.094: With JavaScript disabled, characters and sources remain readable; interactive playback, the timeline and record switching require JavaScript.
en.text.095: Replay Better Workflows evidence, Ledger, Review, Action and Reconciliation in an original eight-scene cartoon film.
en.text.096: Back to the Better Workflows architecture guide
en.text.098: Full-body designs of the six original cartoon characters: Captain Root, Scout Pixel, Ledger, Vera, Sentinel and Echo
en.text.108: Full-body cartoon of Captain Root, a blue fox
en.text.109: Full-body cartoon of Scout Pixel, a coral-red squirrel
en.text.110: Full-body cartoon of Ledger, an indigo otter
en.text.111: Full-body cartoon of Vera, a lavender owl
en.text.112: Full-body cartoon of Sentinel, an amber tortoise
en.text.113: Full-body cartoon of Echo, a teal robot
en.text.115: Captain Root raises a baton in a paper-and-brass archive cinema as six characters prepare to follow a glowing filmstrip path
en.text.116: TaskContract v2 freezes the goal, scope, acceptance, authority and stages; a free-text claim of completion does not change state.
en.text.118: The goal, scope and acceptance criteria are frozen
en.text.119: run.created is the first append-only event
en.text.121: Captain Root and Sentinel cover a branching paper blueprint with a glass bell while a brass camera captures the current state
en.text.123: Bind the current source state to the same frame
en.text.124: If HEAD, index, status, scope or symlinks drift, stop before the next scene and capture again.
en.text.126: The source sentinel binds later evidence, review and actions to the same tree; presentation cannot erase drift.
en.text.128: HEAD, index, status and scoped files are bound
en.text.129: The current tree capture supports later freshness checks
en.text.131: Scout Pixel retrieves evidence cards with fingerprints, clocks, links and wax seals from precisely labeled file drawers
en.text.132: Take evidence from the source, not from a confident tone
en.text.133: Every card needs a kind, producer, payload, digest, dependency and creation time.
en.text.135: Evidence must pass its kind contract, producer allowlist, payload semantics and recomputed digest before the ledger or completion can consume it.
en.text.137: Baseline validation matches the typed payload
en.text.138: The test receipt binds the current revision and command
en.text.139: Source locators and producer metadata are present
en.text.141: Vera compares blue and coral filmstrips in an independent projection room, finding a broken frame and mismatched fingerprints
en.text.142: A Verifier looks for the frame nobody wants to see
en.text.143: Keep both supporting and counter-evidence; a finder cannot stamp approval on its own finding.
en.text.145: This scene is explicitly marked as the review-kernel-v2-pilot observe-only branch: Verifier and finder are separate; conflicting results become INCONCLUSIVE, and missing or ambiguous anchors remain blocking. It ends before action and does not claim extra finder/verifier authority for executable workflows.
en.text.147: An independent verifier rechecks the claim and exact anchor
en.text.148: Counter-evidence shows a mismatched source fingerprint
en.text.150: Ledger the otter runs a brass film machine: ordered event frames enter on the left and a stage map of ready, waiting and completed states emerges on the right
en.text.151: State is derived by replaying events, not simply written down
en.text.152: Append-only events pass through a fixed reducer to produce pending, ready, running, completed or blocked.
en.text.154: expectedLedgerDigest blocks stale writers; unknown dependencies, cycles, exhausted budgets or missing evidence reject a transition.
en.text.156: evidence.attached is appended in order; earlier events are not rewritten
en.text.157: The reducer derives verify complete and review ready
en.text.159: Vera inspects a packaged film with a magnifier while a repairer fixes one crack; five bounded repair tickets and a final wide-angle lens lie on the desk
en.text.161: Repair the crack, then inspect the whole reel
en.text.162: Local repairs have a fixed budget; a final broad review is still required before an action token.
en.text.164: An immutable review package binds base, head, scope, diff, contract, template and sentinel. Adding a finding later invalidates broad completion.
en.text.166: Base, head, scope and diff manifest are frozen
en.text.167: The same stable finding is resolved with evidence
en.text.168: The complete changed surface is reviewed again after local repair
en.text.170: Sentinel the tortoise blocks a bridge over a ravine; Captain Root presents a single glowing token while Echo waits beside sealed film canisters
en.text.171: Keep the bridge raised: bind permission to this attempt
en.text.172: The action token binds action, provider, resource, revision, review, evidence and the idempotency key.
en.text.174: This is a sanitized teaching replay and issues no real token. Executable workflows must still request actions under their own review contract, source freshness, provider binding and protected authorization. After wrapper invocation, a nonzero exit with an unknown outcome is not automatically a safe failure.
en.text.176: A short-lived token binds one provider resource
en.text.177: A single-use reservation awaits the fixed wrapper
en.text.179: Echo the robot aligns with a distant provider beacon at a sunrise archive observatory; receipt rolls, evidence, ledger and review illuminate the completion vault
en.text.180: Open the final vault only after reconciliation
en.text.181: The provider receipt, attempt, source, evidence, ledger, review and terminal sentinel must all match before completion can be declared.
en.text.183: Capture the source again before and after completion, and revalidate acceptance evidence, P0/P1, side effects and live state.
en.text.185: The provider receipt matches the same action attempt
en.text.186: Evidence, ledger, review and sentinel digests all pass
en.text.187: The receipt does not match yet; keep the vault closed
en.text.188: Sending is neither proof of success nor proof of failure. Check the actual provider state first; never blindly resend an unknown outcome.
en.text.190: An unknown attempt requires query reconciliation through the pinned provider. Without fresh absence proof or a successful receipt, there is no completed ending.
en.text.191: The wrapper may have sent the request, but its terminal outcome is unknown
en.text.192: An unknown side-effect outcome blocks completion
en.text.193: The full eight-scene transcript and an alternative ending
en.text.194: Read every scene's dialogue, governance explanation and complete demo records without enabling JavaScript. Playback changes presentation only, never a real run.
en.text.199: Scene 08: the provider outcome unknown ending
en.text.200: Full-body translation draft; independent semantic review is pending. This is not proof of a public release or a completed live run.
en.text.201: JavaScript is disabled: all eight scenes, both endings, characters and sources remain fully readable. Only playback and record switching are disabled.

zh-Hant-TW.text.001: Better Workflows 證據劇場｜把可證明完成拍成一部電影
zh-Hant-TW.text.012: 把 Goal、Source Binding、Finder、Verifier、Ledger、Review、Action 與 Reconciliation 變成一部可以暫停、倒帶、切換結局的卡通電影。
zh-Hant-TW.text.013: 你看到的不是「Agent 說完成」，而是完成如何被證明。
zh-Hant-TW.text.017: 每位角色代表一個不能互相取代的治理責任。
zh-Hant-TW.text.019: 八幕重播：從意圖到可證明完成
zh-Hant-TW.text.020: 按播放讓故事自動推進，或點擊時間軸逐幕檢查。右側卡片把畫面翻回 record、binding 與 derived state；最後一幕可切換「證據完整」和「provider outcome unknown」兩種結局。
zh-Hant-TW.text.022: 一部關於 evidence、state 與 reconciliation 的互動短片
zh-Hant-TW.text.023: SANITIZED TEACHING REPLAY · NOT A LIVE RUN
zh-Hant-TW.text.026: 先把「要完成什麼」拍成底片
zh-Hant-TW.text.027: 沒有凍結的目標、範圍與驗收條件，就沒有可被重播的結局。
zh-Hant-TW.text.031: 選擇最後一幕的 provider 狀態
zh-Hant-TW.text.032: 結局只由可重驗輸入改變，不靠旁白投票。
zh-Hant-TW.text.038: 這些是 sanitized 教學票根；卡片包含 evidence、ledger、finding 與 action state，不把所有記錄冒充成同一種 evidence。
zh-Hant-TW.text.046: 從 contract、events、evidence 與 receipts 重新推導狀態。
zh-Hant-TW.text.049: Provider reconciliation 是查證已發生什麼，不是再送一次請求。
zh-Hant-TW.text.052: 缺 receipt、binding drift 或 unresolved P0/P1 都不能剪成完成結局。
zh-Hant-TW.text.054: 六個卡通人物，六個不能混在一起的責任
zh-Hant-TW.text.055: 點角色可跳到代表場景。Finder 不能驗證自己的 finding；Ledger 只從事件推導狀態；Sentinel 不因畫面漂亮就放行；Echo 遇到 unknown 只查證，不盲目重送。
zh-Hant-TW.text.057: 守住 Goal、scope 與唯一 mutation authority。
zh-Hant-TW.text.060: 沿 exact source 取證，留下 provenance 與時效性資訊。
zh-Hant-TW.text.063: 保存 append-only events，再 deterministic replay。
zh-Hant-TW.text.066: 尋找反證；衝突不是投票，而是 INCONCLUSIVE。
zh-Hant-TW.text.069: 重驗 authority、source、review 與短效 action token。
zh-Hant-TW.text.072: 把 provider receipt 對回 attempt；unknown 不重送。
zh-Hant-TW.text.075: 電影是呈現層；程式與合約才是權威來源
zh-Hant-TW.text.076: 每一幕的敘事都對回 repository 內現有 contract 與實作。頁面不建立 run、不發 action token，也不把生成插圖當成政策輸入。
zh-Hant-TW.text.078: Evidence 必備欄位、typed catalog、ledger authority、terminal states、resume 與 completion 條件。
zh-Hant-TW.text.080: 合法事件、static DAG、attempt budgets、expectedLedgerDigest 與 derived ready set。
zh-Hant-TW.text.082: Kind contract、producer、payload semantics、digest 與時效性重驗。
zh-Hant-TW.text.084: Immutable package、stable finding ID、bounded repair 與 final broad review。
zh-Hant-TW.text.086: Authority、sentinel、evidence、provider binding、reconciliation 與 terminal completion decision。
zh-Hant-TW.text.087: 三種 Replay 解剖章節
zh-Hant-TW.text.088: Ledger replay、evaluator replay 與 provider reconciliation 的輸入、輸出及失敗策略。
zh-Hant-TW.text.090: 本頁是 sanitized、deterministic 的教學重播。畫面與 demo JSON 不可授權 push、merge、deploy 或任何外部副作用；Graph／動畫／旁白也不能取代目前 revision 的 typed evidence 與 provider receipt。
zh-Hant-TW.text.091: Better Workflows Evidence Replay Cinema · Original illustrated edition
zh-Hant-TW.text.094: JavaScript 關閉時仍可閱讀角色與來源；互動播放、時間軸與記錄切換需要 JavaScript。
zh-Hant-TW.text.095: 以八幕原創卡通電影，互動重播 Better Workflows 的證據、Ledger、Review、Action 與 Reconciliation 流程。
zh-Hant-TW.text.096: 回到 Better Workflows 解剖書

zh-Hant-TW.text.110: 靛藍水獺 Ledger 全身卡通人物圖
zh-Hant-TW.text.111: 淡紫色貓頭鷹 Vera 全身卡通人物圖
zh-Hant-TW.text.112: 琥珀色陸龜 Sentinel 全身卡通人物圖
zh-Hant-TW.text.113: 青綠色機器人 Echo 全身卡通人物圖
zh-Hant-TW.text.115: Captain Root 在紙張與黃銅構成的檔案電影院舉起指揮棒，六位角色沿發光底片路徑準備出發
zh-Hant-TW.text.116: TaskContract v2 凍結 goal、scope、acceptance、authority 與 stages；自由文字的「完成」不會改變狀態。
zh-Hant-TW.text.118: 目標、範圍與驗收條件已凍結
zh-Hant-TW.text.119: run.created 成為第一筆 append-only event
zh-Hant-TW.text.121: Captain Root 與 Sentinel 把分支狀紙條藍圖罩在玻璃鐘內，旁邊的黃銅相機記錄當下狀態
zh-Hant-TW.text.123: 把現在的 source 狀態鎖進同一格
zh-Hant-TW.text.124: HEAD、index、status、scope 或 symlink 漂移，下一幕就必須停機重拍。
zh-Hant-TW.text.126: Source sentinel 讓後續 evidence、review 與 action 都指向同一棵 tree；presentation 無法消除 drift。
zh-Hant-TW.text.128: HEAD、index、status 與 scoped files 已綁定
zh-Hant-TW.text.129: 目前 tree capture 可供後續時效性重驗
zh-Hant-TW.text.131: Scout Pixel 從精確標記的檔案抽屜取出帶有指紋、時鐘、鏈結與封蠟的證據卡
zh-Hant-TW.text.132: 證據要從來源拿，不是從語氣裡猜
zh-Hant-TW.text.133: 每張卡都要有 kind、producer、payload、digest、dependency 與建立時間。
zh-Hant-TW.text.135: Evidence 先通過 kind contract、producer allowlist、payload semantics 與 digest 重算，才可能被 ledger 或 completion 消費。
zh-Hant-TW.text.137: Baseline 驗證結果符合 typed payload
zh-Hant-TW.text.138: 測試 receipt 綁定目前 revision 與 command
zh-Hant-TW.text.139: 來源 locator 與產生者 metadata 齊備
zh-Hant-TW.text.141: Vera 在獨立投影室比較藍色與珊瑚色兩條底片，發現破裂影格與不一致的指紋
zh-Hant-TW.text.142: Verifier 的工作，是找出不想看到的那格
zh-Hant-TW.text.143: 確認證據與反證都要留下；finder 不能替自己的 finding 蓋章。
zh-Hant-TW.text.145: 這一幕明確標示為 review-kernel-v2-pilot 的 observe-only 分支：Verifier 與 finder 分離；衝突結果變成 INCONCLUSIVE，missing 或 ambiguous anchor 仍然 blocking。它在 action 前結束，不替可執行 workflow 宣稱額外的 finder/verifier 權限。
zh-Hant-TW.text.147: 獨立 verifier 重驗 claim 與 exact anchor
zh-Hant-TW.text.148: 反證顯示一筆 source fingerprint 不一致
zh-Hant-TW.text.150: Ledger 水獺操作黃銅底片機，左側事件影格依序進入，右側推導出 ready、waiting 與 completed 的舞台地圖
zh-Hant-TW.text.151: 狀態不是被寫下來，而是從事件重播出來
zh-Hant-TW.text.152: Append-only events 經過固定 reducer，才得到 pending、ready、running、completed 或 blocked。
zh-Hant-TW.text.154: expectedLedgerDigest 擋住 stale writer；unknown dependency、cycle、超 budget 或 missing evidence 都會拒絕 transition。
zh-Hant-TW.text.156: evidence.attached 依序追加，舊 event 不改寫
zh-Hant-TW.text.157: Reducer 推導 verify complete、review ready
zh-Hant-TW.text.159: Vera 用放大鏡檢查封裝底片，修復者只補一處裂縫，桌面上有五張有限修復票與最終廣角鏡
zh-Hant-TW.text.161: 只修那條裂縫，然後再看整卷底片
zh-Hant-TW.text.162: 局部 repair 有固定 budget；action token 前還要一次 final broad review。
zh-Hant-TW.text.164: Immutable review package 綁定 base、head、scope、diff、contract、template 與 sentinel。之後新增 finding 會使 broad completion 失效。
zh-Hant-TW.text.166: Base、head、scope 與 diff manifest 已凍結
zh-Hant-TW.text.167: 同一 stable finding 已帶 evidence 解決
zh-Hant-TW.text.168: 局部修復後重新檢查完整 changed surface
zh-Hant-TW.text.170: Sentinel 陸龜在深谷吊橋前舉手擋下，Captain Root 出示唯一發光 token，Echo 與封閉底片罐在旁等待
zh-Hant-TW.text.171: 橋先不放下：token 要把權限綁到這一次
zh-Hant-TW.text.172: Action token 綁 action、provider、resource、revision、review、evidence 與 idempotency key。
zh-Hant-TW.text.174: 本頁是 sanitized teaching replay，不會真的發 token；可執行 workflow 仍須依自己的 review contract、來源時效性、provider binding 與 protected authorization 申請 action。Wrapper 送出後若 outcome unknown，不能把非零退出直接當成安全失敗。
zh-Hant-TW.text.176: 短效 token 綁定唯一 provider resource
zh-Hant-TW.text.177: 一次性 reservation 等待固定 wrapper 執行
zh-Hant-TW.text.179: Echo 機器人在日出檔案天文台對準遠方 provider 信標，收據捲與證據、ledger、review 一起點亮完成金庫
zh-Hant-TW.text.180: 對帳完成，才打開終場金庫
zh-Hant-TW.text.181: Provider receipt、attempt、source、evidence、ledger、review 與 terminal sentinel 全部相符，才能宣告完成。
zh-Hant-TW.text.183: Completion 前後都重新 capture source，並重驗 acceptance evidence、P0/P1、side effects 與 live state。
zh-Hant-TW.text.185: Provider receipt 對回同一 action attempt
zh-Hant-TW.text.186: Evidence、ledger、review 與 sentinel digests 全部通過
zh-Hant-TW.text.187: Receipt 還沒對上，金庫保持關閉
zh-Hant-TW.text.188: 送出不等於成功，也不等於失敗。先查 provider 真實狀態；unknown 不能盲目重送。
zh-Hant-TW.text.190: Unknown attempt 必須先用 pinned provider query reconciliation。沒有 fresh absence proof 或成功 receipt，就沒有完成結局。
zh-Hant-TW.text.191: Wrapper 已可能送出，但 terminal outcome 未知
zh-Hant-TW.text.192: Completion 被 unknown side-effect outcome 阻擋
zh-Hant-TW.text.193: 完整八幕正文與另一種結局
zh-Hant-TW.text.194: 不必啟用 JavaScript，就能閱讀每幕對白、治理說明與全部示範紀錄。播放控制只改變呈現，不改變任何真實 run。
zh-Hant-TW.text.199: 第 08 幕：provider outcome unknown 的結局
zh-Hant-TW.text.200: 完整正文翻譯草稿；尚未通過獨立語義審查，並非正式發布或 live run 的完成證明。
zh-Hant-TW.text.201: JavaScript 已關閉：所有八幕、兩種結局、角色與來源仍可完整閱讀；只有播放與記錄切換停用。
